mentions.heading: Leshan, China facility exposed to US-China trade restrictions
mentions.detail: Leshan, China assembly/test facility owned by 80%-owned JV Leshan-Phoenix; entity list additions, export licenses for China customers
mentions.quote: The U.S. Department of Commerce may add additional Chinese companies to its restricted entity list or unverified list and regulatory bodies of either country may take other actions that could expand licensing requirements or otherwise impact the market for our products and our revenue.

mentions.heading: Tariffs on imported components may reduce profitability
mentions.detail: Tariffs on imported components may force price increases, hurting competitiveness
mentions.quote: In addition, tariffs on components that we import from certain nations that have imposed, or may in the future impose, tariffs may adversely affect our profitability unless we are able to exclude such components from the tariffs or we raise prices for our products, which may result in our products becoming less attractive relative to products offered by our competitors.

mentions.heading: Compliance with import and export laws
mentions.detail: U.S. Export Administration Act; penalties up to denial of export privileges or government contract debarment
mentions.quote: For example, licenses or proper license exceptions are required for the shipment of our products to certain countries under applicable export control regulations, including the provisions of the U.S. Export Administration Act.

mentions.heading: Our power technologies designed for AI use may not capture market share as expected
mentions.detail: Power products for AI data centers; intense competition, possible slower AI adoption due to insufficient power or customer scale-backs
mentions.quote: In addition, if AI-related technologies fail to achieve the effectiveness or adoption levels currently anticipated, including due to insufficient available power or other utilities, or if our customers delay or scale back their AI deployments, demand for our AI-related products and solutions and returns on associated investments could be materially lower than we currently expect.

mentions.heading: Issues related to the responsible use of AI may adversely affect our business
mentions.detail: Association with AI infrastructure may bring reputational harm and regulatory scrutiny; AI regulation may limit adoption
mentions.quote: Further, because AI has become the focus of significant societal and regulatory debate, including concerns about safety, bias, misuse and environmental impact, our association with AI infrastructure could expose us to reputational harm, stakeholder criticism or increased regulatory scrutiny, even if we do not control the design or use of AI systems that incorporate our products.
